exposure: Mode of birth (vaginal, planned cesarean, emergency cesarean)
cohort: Pregnant women with SAMM in the Netherlands from 2004 to 2006
finding: Women who gave birth by cesarean section had a significantly higher risk of postpartum laparotomy compared to those who had a vaginal birth.
mod_finding: The relative risk of postpartum laparotomy was higher for emergency cesarean section (21.8) compared to vaginal birth than for planned cesarean section (10.5).
